critique: The unexpected juxtaposition of a live, self-solving generative maze framed within the lavish, glowing opulence of Beaux-Arts SVG ornamentation—complete with a hidden, playful guinea pig—sparks immediate delight and conceptual novelty. To fully realize a cyber-nature fusion, the rigid architectural pillars and classical cartouche could be softened by encroaching organic code, such as algorithmic ivy or bioluminescent roots breaking through the golden geometry.
